dish.note: Apples baked soft with honey, sultanas and cinnamon, with cream.
dish.how: Core 4 large Granny Smith apples and score a line around the middle of each. Stand them in a baking dish, fill with a mix of 60g sultanas, 40g softened butter, 3 tbsp honey and 1 tsp cinnamon, pour 100ml hot water into the dish and bake at 180C for 45 minutes, spooning the juices over twice, until soft. Serve warm with cream.

steps.text: Core the apples and score a line around the middle of each.
Mix the sultanas, butter, honey and cinnamon and pack into the apples.
Stand the apples in a dish with the hot water and bake at 180C, spooning the juices over twice.
Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with cream.

dish.make_ahead: Stuff the apples up to 4 hours ahead; bake just before dinner
